# Changelog
- [2026-05-20] `dev`, `angular-front` — Fixed `dockerfile-picker` branch/file picker UI: replaced the nested branch dropdown with `app-ds-autocomplete` to match the Git branch selection pattern used by push dialogs, verified Dockerfile rows stay on DS text tokens, added missing `RESOURCE_EDIT.APP_PIPELINE.NO_BRANCHES` i18n keys, and added a focused regression spec. Focused Karma spec, frontend typecheck, and build are green.
- [2026-05-21] `dev` — Fixed API Dockerfile so `docker build` (as run by the app PR pipeline) succeeds locally: (1) rewrote Dockerfile with WORKDIR `/repo` mirroring the repo root so `Directory.Packages.props` is found by all projects including `WebDefaults` (outside `src/Api/`); (2) added `COPY .editorconfig .` so `CA1062` severity suppression from `.editorconfig` is applied inside the container (prevents `TreatWarningsAsErrors` from failing on pre-existing suppressed warnings). Build result: `Build succeeded. 0 Warning(s) 0 Error(s)`, image `ifs-api:pr-test` created and tagged successfully.
- [2026-05-20] `dev` - Added application PR pipeline generation and bootstrap provisioning: app generators now emit `pr.app-pipeline.yml`, shared app PR templates validate code/Docker builds without ACR login or image push, bootstrap creates `[Code] ... - PR` definitions, and full solution tests/build are green.
- [2026-05-20] `dev` — Fixed the next YAML literal-block regression in generated app shared templates: `SyftSbomStep` now indents its `powershell: |` body and `displayName` correctly, `AppPipelineWindowsShellCompatibilityTests` gained the Syft-specific guard, the `app-syft-sbom` shared-template golden was refreshed, and focused plus full solution validations are green after stopping local Api/Mcp process locks.

- [2026-05-20] `dev`, `angular-front` — Rolled back the Container App ACR shared-value UI: `resource-edit` now always renders one ACR service connection field per environment, removed the shared/per-environment toggle and copy-to-all behavior, and updated FR/EN copy accordingly. Also fixed app pipeline YAML generation issues around root `pool:`, SplitInfraCode Common variables in the app bucket, and Azure DevOps directives embedded inside script blocks.
